This is a polled snapshot, not a streaming exchange feed; availability and freshness depend on the upstream source.

status.description: Whether a usable stock price was returned.

provider_symbol.description: Six-digit stock code used by AKShare on success.

price.description: Latest available stock price on success.

close.description: The same latest price, retained for quote compatibility.

previous_close.description: Previous trading day close, when supplied by AKShare.

open.description: Current session opening price, when supplied.

high.description: Current session high price, when supplied.

low.description: Current session low price, when supplied.

timestamp.description: Upstream quote time if provided; may be empty.

retrieved_at.description: UTC time when this snapshot was retrieved.

error.description: Error detail when the task failed.

output.description: Reserved for future structured task output.

tools.name: training_list_tasks
tools.description: List background training and benchmark tasks launched in this server process, newest first, with task id, tool, status, and creation time.

output_schema.description: Launch-only summaries of known background tasks, newest first.

market_data.description: AKShare A-share stock price snapshots, cross-source quotes, historical OHLCV, market capitalization, market status, sector performance, commodities and foreign exchange.

fundamentals.description: Financial statements, company profiles, ratios, growth, ratings, analyst estimates, ESG and quality scores.

valuation.description: DCF, enterprise value, WACC, analyst price targets and intrinsic-value estimates.

filings.description: Search, read, download, and structure regulatory filings. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

ownership.description: Institutional, mutual fund, insider, and 13F holdings. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

calendar.description: Dated corporate events: earnings, dividends, IPOs and stock splits.

macro.description: Macroeconomic series and events, treasury yields, shipping indices and financial curves.

news.description: Financial headlines, articles, company news, and sentiment. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

funds_etf.description: Fund and ETF profiles, holdings, and geographic or sector weights. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

derivatives.description: Local European option pricing and remote implied-volatility surfaces.

crypto.description: Cryptocurrency spot prices and asset listings; historical crypto prices use the market-data group.

onchain.description: Blockchain address and on-chain balance data. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

flows.description: Security money flows and capital flows.

risk.description: Portfolio risk metrics and financial risk scores. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

documents.description: Read local documents, parse PDFs and retrieve earnings call transcripts.

search.description: Search financial data sources, web pages, and reference sources. Route selection follows the configured source policy; data coverage and freshness vary by source, region, and entitlement.

analytics.description: Correlation, factor analysis, and IC or RankIC metrics. Local IC and correlation tools are available with prepared data; factor-analysis proxy calls require the configured remote MCP and entitlement.

backtesting.description: Local rule-strategy backtests, Qlib model-prediction backtests, with optional remote backtest routing.

technical.description: Technical indicators and chart pattern analysis from market prices.

fixed_income.description: Bond pricing, cash flows, scenarios, and risk analytics. Most tools are remote MCP proxies and require the configured LSEG server plus entitlement; no remote capability is guaranteed locally.

rates.description: Interest-rate swap pricing and risk measures. Most tools are remote MCP proxies and require the configured LSEG server plus entitlement; no remote capability is guaranteed locally.

sentiment.description: News sentiment and local text-model sentiment inference.

data_pipeline.description: Import local data, initialize Qlib datasets and export engineered features.

modeling.description: Model training, background research-task management, time-series forecasting, and Qlib benchmark workflows.

reports.description: Generate PDF research reports from analysis text and optional market charts.
